text:
My dear Mother and Father,

I must confess that camp is no more than tolerable, for the table is a very indifferent one, and the friend who shares my room snores with a violence that leaves me little rest. Yesterday we went upon the water in a small boat, which I overturned, to the great diversion of the whole party; and I cannot express the mortification of it.

There is, however, a young lady of the name of Kayla, whom I find very agreeable; she is from Ohio, and knows a great deal more of horses than anybody here. We walk down to the lake after dinner and converse upon a variety of subjects; and though I fancy she likes me, I am not certain of it.

Will you be so good as to send me some refreshments, and the device which I was so foolish as to leave behind? The advisers are rather strict, but upon the whole I have no great reason to complain of them.

Yours affectionately, Jake

P.S. Pray do not suffer Max to make use of my room.
